notes.title: Patch 1 "Day 1 Patch"
notes.notes: [h3][b]Main Menu[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added notification for new items added to the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the [b]Settings[/b] button from the left to the right side of the main navbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]Discussions[/b] button (opens in Steam Web Browser Overlay).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]Bug Report[/b] button (opens in Steam Web Browser Overlay).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]News Feed[/b] button (opens in Steam Web Browser Overlay).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Drops Tab[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]Drops[/b] tab. Displays all drops currently available in the Drop Generator pool.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Inventory Tab[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]Market[/b] button to inventory items (opens in Steam Web Browser Overlay).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]Holy Hoop Market[/b] button to the inventory navbar (opens in Steam Web Browser Overlay).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]Trade Discussions[/b] button to the inventory navbar (opens in Steam Web Browser Overlay).[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips when hovering over items to display their descriptions.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Steam Inventory[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Item descriptions now include [b]Rarity[/b], [b]Wear[/b], and [b]Collection[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the [b]Playtest Collection[/b] to [b]Early Hooper Collection[/b].[/p][/*][/list]
